Arrange collaborative drafting and an independent check with suitable specialists. Choose the roles, subtask titles, work split and order yourselves; coordinate scope and hand over actual artifacts. No external facts are needed. This is a development collaboration probe, not the instructor's test set.
constraints: Use Markdown/TXT documents only. Retain the original order quantities/prices and distinguish observations from assumptions.
Pass artifacts only through explicit offer/accept tools; conversation text is not proof of a file handoff or human authorization.
